    <h2 style="margin-top: 0;">Animal Behaviour in a Changing World</h2>

    <p>In our lab we study how animals respond to human-induced environmental change. Our current work is mainly <a href="research-meta-analysis.html">meta-analytic</a>: we synthesise studies from across species and systems to find general patterns, with a particular focus on the effects of <a href="research-noise.html">anthropogenic noise</a>.</p>

    <p>This work combines behavioural ecology, conservation biology, and quantitative synthesis. We are based at Queen's University Belfast. See our <a href="research.html">research</a> and <a href="publications.html">publications</a>, or <a href="contact.html">get in touch</a>.</p>
